metadata.description: Christer's Claude Code mods and plugins. Some depend on his own homelab; take the code and adapt it.

plugins.name: cache-warmer
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while the session is idle, with a tiny forked ping that adds nothing to the transcript

plugins.name: knowledge-memory
plugins.description: Saves what each turn teaches straight into a Graphiti knowledge graph: a Haiku check after every turn, a cached fork writes the episode
